archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with Neo-Brutalist High-Contrast

layout_spacing.card_style: bg-white border-2 border-[#0F172A] rounded-xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-[#6366F1] text-white font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#0F172A] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] hover:bg-[#4F46E5] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#0F172A] font-bold py-3 px-6 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#0F172A] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(15,23,42,1)] hover:bg-slate-50 active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all

backgrounds.description: Abstract pastel waves, use for login/signup backgrounds with 50% opacity white overlay

testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='login-form-submit-button', data-testid='course-card-123', data-testid='poll-vote-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Node.js purely as ECMAScript Modules (type: 'module').
Frontend MUST be built using React + TailwindCSS + Shadcn/UI primitives. Customize Shadcn primitives strictly using the defined Neo-brutalist card_style and button properties.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Import and use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text.
Bento grid pattern is MANDATORY for all dashboard views. Use the 'Grid Layout Technical Rules' where grid items are direct children.
Gamification features (Leaderboard, Points, Tiers) must use the specific 'gamification_tiers' hex codes.
Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements, buttons, links, and forms as outlined in the testing conventions.
Use Socket.io for all real-time events (Polling, Leaderboard updates, WebRTC signaling).
